newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end at record, Ericsson strong.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end at record, Ericsson strong.

text.p: 1600 GMT - Swedish shares ended at a record high on Friday for the fourth consecutive day, supported by strong international trends.
* Stockholm general index rises 0.90 percent to 2,773.23
* Telecoms group Ericsson leaped 10.5 crowns to 270.5

* Holding company Incentive rose three to 536 crowns after posting a 1996 profit after financial items including associated companies of 5.23 billion crowns against market expectations of 5.35 billion.
